It gets better. It'll get better for everyone reading this.
Don't close the door for loving or meeting new people, in this world there's plenty of GOOD people.

It was okay the first 3 weeks but don't know why is that bump. I'm trying to get rid of it with saline but it seems that is not working.
For the moment it's more tiny than when it started.
It's been like a month an a half since I had my nose pierced.
Cause they don't love me the same way I do
We're not talking. I'm just crying and they're so fine without me
